review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H4 replaces an unbounded queue with a bounded queue and byte-aware admission control, which could prevent warehouse ingestion workflows from filling memory with large history events. This is a substantive, bounded reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion, but the chunk lacks complete implementation and end-to-end verification, including consumer-side,
